description: This file defines a PHP class 'WorkShiftModel' within the OrangeHRM project. It implements the 'Normalizable' interface and uses traits for serialization. The class encapsulates the data model for work shifts, including properties such as id, name, hoursPerDay, startTime, and endTime. It provides a constructor that initializes the model with an entity of type 'WorkShift' and sets up filters and attribute names for serialization and normalization purposes.

classes.name: WorkShiftModel
classes.description: A data model class representing a work shift, used for API serialization and normalization within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.description: Initializes a new instance of the WorkShiftModel with a WorkShift entity, and sets filters and attribute names for serialization.
